caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical object that appears to consist of a circular bell mounted on a rectangular metal plate. The bell is colored in shades of brown and gray with subtle shading to indicate metallic texture and curvature, and it is positioned on the left side of the composition. At the center of the bell, there is a smaller circular, knob-like feature in a lighter beige or off-white color. Behind and above the bell, the rectangular metal plate, rendered in light gray, contains three visible holes and irregular contours. Attached to this plate are two yellow coiled springs and a yellow lever-like mechanism that extends to the right. A thin, looped wire protrudes from the top of the plate, also rendered in a light gray with faint shadowing. The background of the image is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the central mechanical components.
title: Gong
